name: Do I need permits for a shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits are typically required for shower or tub upgrades in the East Bay area, especially if the project involves significant changes to plumbing, electrical, or structural elements. Minor cosmetic updates may not require a permit. Securing the necessary permits ensures that your renovation complies with local building codes, which protects your home's safety and value. Frasheski Construction can assist in navigating the permitting process for properties in Berkeley, Oakland, and surrounding East Bay cities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually required for shower or tub upgrades in the East Bay if plumbing, electrical, or structural changes occur. Frasheski Construction can help with the permitting process.
